physicalNotes: Radius 1.415 +/- 0.047 solar radii from Psaridi et al. 2023, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-622 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023A&A...675A..39P/abstract): 984,416 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 1.313 +/- 0.079 solar masses from Psaridi et al. 2023, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-622 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023A&A...675A..39P/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 6400 +/- 100 K from Psaridi et al. 2023, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-622 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023A&A...675A..39P/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
